```{r setup}
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
library(nflreadr)
library(janitor)
library(lme4)
library(glmmTMB)
library(brms)
library(broom.mixed)

theme_set(theme_minimal())
```

# Load data

```{r load-data}
seasons = 2015:2025
season_type_keep = c("REG")

pbp_raw = load_pbp(seasons) |>
  clean_names()

officials_raw = load_officials(seasons) |>
  clean_names()
```

```{r clean-data}
pbp = pbp_raw %>%
  filter(season %in% seasons) %>%
  filter(if ("season_type" %in% names(.)) season_type %in% season_type_keep else TRUE) %>%
  filter(!is.na(game_id))

officials = officials_raw %>%
  filter(season %in% seasons) %>%
  filter(if ("season_type" %in% names(.)) season_type %in% season_type_keep else TRUE)
```

# Process referee data

```{r referee-game}
referee_game = officials |>
  filter(position == "Referee") |>
  transmute(
    old_game_id = game_id,
    season,
    week,
    lead_referee = official_name,
    lead_ref_id = official_id
  )
```

# Team-game penalty data

```{r team-game-data}
team_game_level = pbp |>
  filter(!is.na(posteam)) |>
  group_by(game_id, old_game_id, season, week, season_type,
           home_team, away_team, posteam, defteam) |>
  summarise(
    team_plays = n(),
    team_penalties = sum(penalty == 1 & penalty_team == first(posteam), na.rm = TRUE),
    team_penalty_yards = sum(if_else(penalty_team == first(posteam), penalty_yards, 0), na.rm = TRUE),
    offensive_penalty_rows = sum(penalty == 1 & posteam == penalty_team, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_ydstogo = mean(ydstogo, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_abs_score_diff = mean(abs(score_differential), na.rm = TRUE),
    early_down_rate = mean(down %in% c(1, 2), na.rm = TRUE),
    pass_rate = mean(play_type == "pass", na.rm = TRUE),
    rush_rate = mean(play_type == "run", na.rm = TRUE),
    is_home = as.integer(first(posteam) == first(home_team)),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

team_game_model_data = team_game_level |>
  left_join(referee_game, by = c("old_game_id", "season", "week")) |>
  filter(!is.na(lead_referee))
```

# EDA

```{r team-penalty-hist}
team_game_model_data |>
  ggplot(aes(x = team_penalties)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of team penalties per game",
    x = "Team penalties",
    y = "Number of team-games"
  )
```

```{r raw-referee-summary}
ref_raw_summary = team_game_model_data |>
  group_by(lead_referee) |>
  summarise(
    games = n(),
    mean_team_penalties = mean(team_penalties, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_team_penalty_yards = mean(team_penalty_yards, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  filter(games >= 8) |>
  arrange(desc(mean_team_penalties))

ref_raw_summary |>
  slice_head(n = 15)
```

```{r raw-referee-plot}
ref_raw_summary |>
  slice_max(order_by = mean_team_penalties, n = 10) |>
  mutate(lead_referee = fct_reorder(lead_referee, mean_team_penalties)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = lead_referee, y = mean_team_penalties)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Highest raw average team penalties by lead referee",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Mean team penalties"
  )
```

# Negative binomial crossed random effects model

```{r fit-nb-crossed}
if (file.exists("models/nb_crossed_mod.rds")) {
  nb_crossed_mod = readRDS("models/nb_crossed_mod.rds")
} else {
  nb_crossed_mod = glmmTMB(
    team_penalties ~ offset(log(team_plays)) +
      is_home + mean_abs_score_diff + pass_rate + early_down_rate +
      (1 | lead_referee) + (1 | posteam) + (1 | defteam),
    family = nbinom2,
    data = team_game_model_data
  )

  saveRDS(nb_crossed_mod, "models/nb_crossed_mod.rds")
}

summary(nb_crossed_mod)
```

# Referee, offensive team, and defensive opponent effects

```{r referee-effects}
ref_effects = ranef(nb_crossed_mod)$cond$lead_referee |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column("lead_referee") |>
  rename(ref_effect = `(Intercept)`)

ref_effects |>
  arrange(desc(ref_effect)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)
```

```{r referee-effects-plot}
ref_effects |>
  mutate(lead_referee = fct_reorder(lead_referee, ref_effect)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = lead_referee, y = ref_effect)) +
  geom_point() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Lead referee random effects",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Estimated referee effect"
  )
```

```{r posteam-effects}
posteam_effects = ranef(nb_crossed_mod)$cond$posteam |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column("posteam") |>

posteam_effects |>
  arrange(desc(posteam_effect)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)
```

```{r posteam-effects-plot}
posteam_effects |>
  mutate(posteam = fct_reorder(posteam, posteam_effect)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = posteam, y = posteam_effect)) +
  geom_point() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Offensive team random effects",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Estimated offensive team effect"
  )
```

```{r defteam-effects}
defteam_effects = ranef(nb_crossed_mod)$cond$defteam |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column("defteam") |>
  rename(defteam_effect = `(Intercept)`)

defteam_effects |>
  arrange(desc(defteam_effect)) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)
```

```{r defteam-effects-plot}
defteam_effects |>
  mutate(defteam = fct_reorder(defteam, defteam_effect)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = defteam, y = defteam_effect)) +
  geom_point() +
```

# Bayesian crossed random effects model

```{r fit-bayesian-crossed}
# This chunk can take a long time.
# After the first successful run, the fitted model is saved to models/bayes_crossed_mod.rds.
# For later runs, the saved model is loaded automatically.

if (file.exists("models/bayes_crossed_mod.rds")) {
  bayes_crossed_mod = readRDS("models/bayes_crossed_mod.rds")
} else {
  bayes_crossed_mod = brm(
    team_penalties ~ offset(log(team_plays)) +
      is_home + mean_abs_score_diff + pass_rate + early_down_rate +
      (1 | lead_referee) + (1 | posteam) + (1 | defteam),
    family = negbinomial(),
    data = team_game_model_data,
    prior = c(
      prior(normal(0, 1), class = "b"),
      prior(normal(0, 2), class = "Intercept"),
      prior(student_t(3, 0, 2.5), class = "sd"),
      prior(student_t(3, 0, 2.5), class = "shape")
    ),
    chains = 4,
    iter = 2000,
    cores = 10,
    seed = 123
  )

  saveRDS(bayes_crossed_mod, "models/bayes_crossed_mod.rds")
}

summary(bayes_crossed_mod)
```

```{r bayes-referee-effects}
bayes_ref_effects = ranef(bayes_crossed_mod)$lead_referee[, , "Intercept"] |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column("lead_referee")

bayes_ref_effects |>
  arrange(desc(Estimate)) |>
  select(lead_referee, Estimate, Q2.5, Q97.5) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)
```

```{r bayes-referee-effects-plot}
bayes_ref_effects |>
  mutate(lead_referee = fct_reorder(lead_referee, Estimate)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = lead_referee, y = Estimate)) +
  geom_point() +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = Q2.5, ymax = Q97.5), width = 0.2) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Posterior referee effects with 95% intervals",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Posterior referee effect"
  )
```

```{r posterior-predictive-check}
pp_check(bayes_crossed_mod)
```

```{r bayes-team-effects}
bayes_posteam_effects = ranef(bayes_crossed_mod)$posteam[, , "Intercept"] |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column("posteam")

bayes_defteam_effects = ranef(bayes_crossed_mod)$defteam[, , "Intercept"] |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column("defteam")

bayes_posteam_effects |>
  arrange(desc(Estimate)) |>
  select(posteam, Estimate, Q2.5, Q97.5) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)

bayes_defteam_effects |>

  select(defteam, Estimate, Q2.5, Q97.5) |>
  slice_head(n = 10)
```

# Penalty-event data

```{r penalty-event-data}
penalty_events_model_data = pbp |>
  filter(penalty == 1, !is.na(penalty_type), !is.na(posteam)) |>
  group_by(old_game_id, season, week) |>
  mutate(
    mean_abs_score_diff = mean(abs(score_differential), na.rm = TRUE),
    pass_rate = mean(play_type == "pass", na.rm = TRUE),
    early_down_rate = mean(down %in% c(1, 2), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  transmute(
    game_id,
    old_game_id,
    season,
    week,
    posteam,
    defteam,
    penalty_type,
    is_home = as.integer(posteam == home_team),
    mean_abs_score_diff,
    pass_rate,
    early_down_rate
  ) |>
  left_join(referee_game, by = c("old_game_id", "season", "week")) |>
  filter(!is.na(lead_referee))
```

# Penalty type EDA

```{r penalty-type-counts}
penalty_type_counts = penalty_events_model_data |>
  count(penalty_type, sort = TRUE)

penalty_type_counts |>
  slice_head(n = 15)
```

```{r penalty-type-counts-plot}
penalty_type_counts |>
  slice_head(n = 15) |>
  mutate(penalty_type = fct_reorder(penalty_type, n)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = penalty_type, y = n)) +
  geom_col() +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Most common penalty types",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of penalties called"
  )
```

```{r ref-type-heatmap}
top_penalty_types = penalty_type_counts |>
  slice_head(n = 6) |>
  pull(penalty_type)

ref_type_heatmap = penalty_events_model_data |>
  filter(penalty_type %in% top_penalty_types) |>
  group_by(lead_referee, penalty_type) |>
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") |>
  group_by(lead_referee) |>
  mutate(pct = n / sum(n)) |>
  filter(sum(n) >= 50) |>
  ungroup()

ref_type_heatmap |>
  ggplot(aes(x = penalty_type, y = lead_referee, fill = pct)) +
  geom_tile() +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "darkred", labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Referee penalty type composition",
    x = NULL,
    y = NULL,
    fill = "Share"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5)
  )
```

# Penalty type mixed-effects models

```{r create-penalty-indicators}
penalty_events_model_data = penalty_events_model_data |>
  mutate(
    is_offensive_holding = as.integer(penalty_type == "Offensive Holding"),
    is_false_start = as.integer(penalty_type == "False Start"),
    is_defensive_pass_interference = as.integer(penalty_type == "Defensive Pass Interference"),
    is_defensive_holding = as.integer(penalty_type == "Defensive Holding"),
    is_unnecessary_roughness = as.integer(penalty_type == "Unnecessary Roughness"),
    is_defensive_offside = as.integer(penalty_type == "Defensive Offside")
  )
```

```{r fit-penalty-type-models}
# These models may take some time.
# After the first successful run, the fitted model list is saved to models/penalty_type_models.rds.
# For later runs, the saved model list is loaded automatically.

if (file.exists("models/penalty_type_models.rds")) {
  penalty_type_models = readRDS("models/penalty_type_models.rds")
} else {
  offensive_holding_mod = glmer(
    is_offensive_holding ~ is_home + mean_abs_score_diff + pass_rate + early_down_rate +
      (1 | lead_referee) + (1 | posteam) + (1 | defteam),
    family = binomial,
    data = penalty_events_model_data
  )

  false_start_mod = glmer(
    is_false_start ~ is_home + mean_abs_score_diff + pass_rate + early_down_rate +
      (1 | lead_referee) + (1 | posteam) + (1 | defteam),
    family = binomial,
    data = penalty_events_model_data
  )

  defensive_pass_interference_mod = glmer(
    is_defensive_pass_interference ~ is_home + mean_abs_score_diff + pass_rate + early_down_rate +
      (1 | lead_referee) + (1 | posteam) + (1 | defteam),
    family = binomial,
    data = penalty_events_model_data
  )

  defensive_holding_mod = glmer(
    is_defensive_holding ~ is_home + mean_abs_score_diff + pass_rate + early_down_rate +
      (1 | lead_referee) + (1 | posteam) + (1 | defteam),
    family = binomial,
    data = penalty_events_model_data
  )

  unnecessary_roughness_mod = glmer(
    is_unnecessary_roughness ~ is_home + mean_abs_score_diff + pass_rate + early_down_rate +
      (1 | lead_referee) + (1 | posteam) + (1 | defteam),
    family = binomial,
    data = penalty_events_model_data
  )

  defensive_offside_mod = glmer(
    is_defensive_offside ~ is_home + mean_abs_score_diff + pass_rate + early_down_rate +
      (1 | lead_referee) + (1 | posteam) + (1 | defteam),
    family = binomial,
    data = penalty_events_model_data
  )

  penalty_type_models = list(
    "Offensive Holding" = offensive_holding_mod,
    "False Start" = false_start_mod,
    "Defensive Pass Interference" = defensive_pass_interference_mod,
    "Defensive Holding" = defensive_holding_mod,
    "Unnecessary Roughness" = unnecessary_roughness_mod,
    "Defensive Offside" = defensive_offside_mod
  )

  saveRDS(penalty_type_models, "models/penalty_type_models.rds")
}
```

# Penalty type referee effects

```{r extract-penalty-type-effects}
extract_ref_effects = function(model, penalty_label) {
  ranef(model)$lead_referee |>
    as.data.frame() |>
    rownames_to_column("lead_referee") |>
    rename(ref_effect = `(Intercept)`) |>
    mutate(penalty_type = penalty_label)
}

all_ref_effects = bind_rows(
  extract_ref_effects(penalty_type_models[["Offensive Holding"]], "Offensive Holding"),
  extract_ref_effects(penalty_type_models[["False Start"]], "False Start"),
  extract_ref_effects(penalty_type_models[["Defensive Pass Interference"]], "Defensive Pass Interference"),
  extract_ref_effects(penalty_type_models[["Defensive Holding"]], "Defensive Holding"),
  extract_ref_effects(penalty_type_models[["Unnecessary Roughness"]], "Unnecessary Roughness"),
  extract_ref_effects(penalty_type_models[["Defensive Offside"]], "Defensive Offside")
)

all_ref_effects |>
  arrange(penalty_type, desc(ref_effect)) |>
  group_by(penalty_type) |>
  slice_head(n = 5)
```

```{r plot-penalty-type-effects}
top_bottom_ref_effects = all_ref_effects |>
  group_by(penalty_type) |>
  slice_max(order_by = ref_effect, n = 5) |>
  bind_rows(
    all_ref_effects |>
      group_by(penalty_type) |>
      slice_min(order_by = ref_effect, n = 5)
  ) |>
  ungroup()

top_bottom_ref_effects |>
  mutate(lead_referee = fct_reorder(lead_referee, ref_effect)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = lead_referee, y = ref_effect)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "red") +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ penalty_type, nrow = 2, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(
    title = "Referee random effects by penalty type",
    subtitle = "Top and bottom 5 referees per penalty type",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Estimated referee effect"
  )
```

```{r penalty-type-aic}
model_aic = AIC(
  penalty_type_models[["Offensive Holding"]],
  penalty_type_models[["False Start"]],
  penalty_type_models[["Defensive Pass Interference"]],
  penalty_type_models[["Defensive Holding"]],
  penalty_type_models[["Unnecessary Roughness"]],
  penalty_type_models[["Defensive Offside"]]
) |>
  rownames_to_column("model") |>
  mutate(model = names(penalty_type_models)) |>
  arrange(AIC)

model_aic
```
